candidates.evidence: Full authenticated captured-images REST request p50 about 391 ms for 30 lines / 150 versions in initial probe; per-version line fetches and repeated latest/retention queries.
candidates.approach: Batch presentation reads with request-local data; preserve visibility, latest and retention rules.
candidates.risk: Low to medium: read-only behavior; explicit lifecycle-state characterization required.

candidates.evidence: Workspace list calls version_ref separately for every base and pending image; latest() executes SQL on every call. Full authenticated path grows with workspace count.
candidates.approach: Bulk load latest version references in the service/repository layer for workspace lists.
candidates.risk: Medium: shared workspace serialization used by REST and socket events.

candidates.evidence: Real temporary Git repository through production service and existing fake runtime: 1/10/30 untracked files => 6/15/35 runtime calls, p50 6.898/29.061/81.798 ms. QEMU SSH overhead not included.
candidates.approach: Bounded concurrent independent per-file diffs under the existing repository lock.
candidates.risk: Medium: cancellation and child process lifetime must remain correct.

candidates.evidence: auto_stop_inactive_workspaces performs full workspace reload per candidate (relations and credentials), even for disabled policies; frequent heartbeat path.
candidates.approach: Narrow, batch current eligibility reads while retaining admission checks.
candidates.risk: Higher: stale-state and lifecycle safety; not chosen for shortlist.

candidates.evidence: Every part event clones every part in the current assistant message, recursively freezes and rebuilds session snapshots. Cost scales with long tool-heavy turns.
candidates.approach: Profile and selectively copy changed parts while preserving immutable snapshots.
candidates.risk: Higher: aliasing and native UI validation; no device measurement yet.

candidates.evidence: buildChildSessionIdMap filters unmatched children for every part and the Vue chat panel depends on all retained transcripts; fallback matching can be quadratic.
candidates.approach: Index title matches per parent, reduce reactive invalidation after profiling.
candidates.risk: Medium: only fallback/large-fanout workloads; lower confidence in real-world impact.
